jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Company:
Aaratech Inc.
Employment Type:
Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)
Experience:
2-3 years
Compensation:
$70,000 – $80,000 per year
Work Mode:
On-Site / Hybrid
Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Engineer to help build and maintain data pipelines on cloud platforms. You will develop ETL/ELT workflows, bring data together from multiple systems, and help keep the data that powers reporting and analytics accurate and reliable.
What You Will Do

• Build and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines using tools such as Azure Data Factory, SSIS, or AWS Glue.
• Pull data together from multiple sources — databases, files, APIs — into clean, usable datasets.
• Write SQL to transform, join, and validate data.
• Use Python scripts to automate routine data tasks.
• Monitor pipelines and help troubleshoot issues when data does not land as expected.
• Work with analysts and business teams to understand what data they need and deliver it.
• Document your pipelines so others can understand and maintain them.
What We Are Looking For

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience.
• 2+ years working with data — ETL development, data integration, SQL development, or database work all count.
• Good SQL skills: comfortable with joins, aggregations, and writing queries against real-world data.
• Experience with at least one ETL tool (Azure Data Factory, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, or similar).
• Basic familiarity with data warehouse concepts (tables, schemas, fact/dimension basics).
• Some Python scripting exposure, or a strong desire to learn it.
• Clear communicator and reliable problem-solver.
Tools You Will Work With

• Cloud: Azure (Data Factory, Synapse) or AWS (Glue, Redshift) — experience with either is fine.
• Databases & warehouses: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, or Databricks.
• Languages: SQL and Python.
• Version control: Git.
• Reporting tools your data will feed: Power BI or Tableau.
Nice to Have (Not Required)

• Any exposure to dbt, Airflow, or Databricks notebooks.
• Awareness of CI/CD or basic DevOps concepts.
• Experience with Power BI or Tableau.
• Certifications such as Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203), AWS Data Engineer Associate, or SnowPro Core — helpful but not required.
About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across data & analytics, cybersecurity, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations build scalable cloud data platforms, optimize data workflows, and enable data-driven decision-making through modern engineering practices.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Company:
Aaratech Inc.
Employment Type:
Full-Time, W2 (deployed to client projects)
Experience:
2–4 years
Compensation:
$70,000 – $80,000 per year
Work Mode:
On-Site / Hybrid
Work Authorization

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
Why This Role?

Pharma analytics sits at the intersection of science and commercial strategy — and it pays for precision. Master syndicated data, real-world evidence, and market-access analytics in one of the few niches where domain knowledge alone can double your market value.
Job Summary

Aaratech Inc. is seeking a Data Analyst – Pharma & Life Sciences to turn commercial, clinical, and real-world data into insight. You will build brand and field-force reporting, work with industry-standard syndicated datasets, and deliver analysis that supports launch performance, market access, and compliant decision-making.
Key Responsibilities

Gather, clean, and analyze pharma commercial datasets — prescription (Rx), medical/pharmacy claims, and sales data — using SQL and Python.
Design and maintain dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for brand performance, market share, and field-force effectiveness.
Work with syndicated data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, and Komodo Health.
Support real-world evidence (RWE), patient-journey, and payer/market-access analytics.
Handle clinical or regulated data with GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 awareness, maintaining data integrity and traceability.
Ensure data quality and compliance across reporting platforms.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to commercial and medical-affairs stakeholders.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Analytics, or a related field.
2–4 years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably in pharma, biotech, or life sciences.
Strong, hands-on SQL skills — complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and query optimization.
Proficiency with Power BI or Tableau, plus advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables, advanced formulas).
Hands-on experience with pharmaceutical, clinical, or healthcare claims data.
Strong analytical, data-storytelling, and stakeholder-communication skills.

Tools & Technologies You Will Use

Analytics & querying: SQL (Oracle, SQL Server, Snowflake), Python (pandas, NumPy), SAS.
BI & visualization: Power BI (DAX, Power Query), Tableau, Excel.
Syndicated & domain data: IQVIA (Xponent, DDD, LAAD), Symphony Health, Komodo Health, specialty pharmacy data.
Domain systems: Veeva CRM, Salesforce; cloud platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or AWS/Azure data services.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of HIPAA, GxP, and 21 CFR Part 11 data-compliance concepts.
Familiarity with patient-level data (PLD), longitudinal claims, or HCP/HCO master data (MDM).
Exposure to launch analytics, forecasting, or incentive-compensation reporting.
Certifications such as Microsoft PL-300, Tableau Desktop Specialist, or Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate are a plus.

About Aaratech Inc.

Aaratech Inc. is a technology-driven organization delivering innovative solutions across cybersecurity, data & analytics, healthcare, and enterprise domains. We are committed to helping organizations transform data into actionable insights through advanced analytics, modern technologies, and data-driven innovation.

Show more

Show less

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Position:
Data Analyst – Power BI & SQL & MES
Location:
Waukegan, IL 60087 – 100% Onsite
Duration:
36-Month Contract

This is NOT open for sponsorship or 3rd party representation.

Local candidates are preferred, must be onsite.

I am looking for a hands-on Data Analyst with 10+ years U.S. professional experience
to develop dashboards, analyze operational data, and provide actionable insights to business and operations leadership. Must come from a Manufacturing background.

QUALIFICATIONS

Strong Power BI dashboard development experience
SQL – ability to write queries and analyze data
Must come from a manufacturing background with experience with MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

Advanced Microsoft Excel
Data cleansing, transformation, validation, and analysis
KPI/dashboard development and reporting
Experience combining data from multiple systems/sources
Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills
Experience gathering requirements directly from business stakeholders
Ability to work 100% onsite in Waukegan, IL

In this role you will

Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and KPI reporting
Write SQL queries to extract and analyze data
Clean, transform, validate, and reconcile large datasets
Identify trends, performance gaps, and root causes
Automate recurring reporting and improve existing dashboards
Translate business needs into reporting and analytics solutions
Present findings to business and operations leadership
Support operational performance and continuous improvement initiatives

Preferred skills

SAP, MES, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Power Apps, manufacturing analytics, supply chain analytics, pharmaceutical experience, Lean/Six Sigma, or Operational Excellence.

About us…Sterling Engineering, in business for 57 years …we offer FULL BENEFITS!
As a Sterling Engineering W2 employee on contract, you receive a Full Employee Benefits Package that includes Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, 3 Medical plans to choose from, Dental & Vision plans, 401(k) with a match, and an Employee Stock Ownership (ESOP) plan.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information.
